summary: Experienced Corporate Recruiter who is self‑motivated, results driven, highly responsive and able to prioritize effectively to accomplish multiple tasks and stay calm under pressure. Offering over 6 years of recruiting, human resources and staffing experience with a Bachelor's Degree in Human Resources Management. Experience with full life‑cycle recruiting of qualified IT professionals including college graduates, experienced software developers, business/technical consultants, sales executives, project managers, and executive level staff.

experience.title: Recruiting and HR Manager
responsibilities: Lead end‑to‑end recruitment for all business units across ENAVATE and Celenia North America.
Develop and execute recruitment strategies, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and hiring.
Streamline recruiting processes, update procedures, and maintain ATS.
Partner with hiring managers to define role requirements and candidate profiles.
Coordinate interview schedules, provide coaching on interview techniques, and conduct behavioral interviews.
Negotiate offers, manage employment agencies, and maintain relationships with colleges and universities.
Oversee onboarding, new hire orientation, and training programs.
Administer benefits, payroll, and HRIS functions for North America employees.
Handle terminations, exit interviews, and employee relations.

experience.title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
responsibilities: Recruited shift supervisors and managers across 450+ U.S. locations.
Sourced talent via CareerBuilder, LinkedIn Recruiter, Indeed, and Snagajob.
Managed job postings, applicant screening, phone screens, and background checks.
Generated offer letters and coordinated with hiring managers.
Implemented recruiting best practices and trained field managers.
Tracked candidates in Infor Talent Management and CareerBuilder TalentNetwork.

experience.title: Manager of Employee Recruitment & Development / Recruitment Specialist
responsibilities: Recruited software developers, testers, sales managers, and executives for a technology consulting firm.
Conducted full recruiting lifecycle: phone screens, on‑site interviews, offers, and salary negotiations.
Managed employee referral program and conducted exit interviews.
Prepared monthly ER&D reports for the Executive Board.
Supervised HR Generalist and Benefits Administrator.

experience.title: Regional HR Manager / Recruiter
responsibilities: Handled all HR administration for a Denver office of 75 employees.
Conducted new hire orientations, exit interviews, benefits coordination, and leave administration.
Managed visa processing and HRIS data entry.
Advised managers on employee policies and staffing initiatives.
Recruited IT professionals and managed relationships with contracting agencies.

experience.title: Corporate Recruiter / Staffing
responsibilities: Recruited technical and functional IT professionals from college and open market.
Represented the firm at job fairs, college campuses, and recruiting events.
Screened thousands of college resumes and scheduled campus interviews.
Created training curriculum for college interview presentations.
Coordinated staffing assignments and maintained staffing pipeline reports.

experience.title: Human Resources Coordinator
responsibilities: Coordinated recruiting, interview setup, and job offers.
Conducted new hire orientations and handled employee inquiries on benefits and policies.
Administered benefits, 401(k), and HRIS database entries.
Developed employee appreciation programs and coordinated company events.
